_notes: Channel is phone-verified (custom thumbnails, 100 uploads/day channel limit). The API quota (10,000 units/day by default) is the real limit: the upload job uploads in episode order and stops cleanly at the first quotaExceeded, leaving the rest READY for the next 3-hourly run. Publish slots: hourly 08:00-22:00 IST, one video per slot, in queue order. Until the Google Cloud project passes YouTube's API audit, YouTube may keep API uploads private even when publishAt is set.
